Read out of the Охридски пролог’s heading for 5. децембар ст. ст., „Преподобни Карион и Захарија.“ — with «Преподобни» left off, that being the `venerable` grade `types` keeps, and the first of the two names taken, the heading giving the pair nothing but their bare forenames. `sr-foldpred.mjs` measured the folded string at 0 other holders, which is worth saying because `karion-the-martyr` carries the same English display name: that folder’s only form is the Greek «Καρίων» and no Serbian string folds against this one.

attestations.note: The life page `https://www.saint.gr/2997/saint.aspx` heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 24 Νοεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. Nothing in the corpus answers to this name, but the corpus does keep `zacharias-son-of-carion`, whom this page names as his son in the flesh and in the spirit and sends to 24 March, so the two folders are related. The page's one saying it quotes is credited to the Euergetinos, page 468. The page gives no year and no monastery, so there is no `dates` object and no `office`. No hymn. No asterisk and not the sentence «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη η ύπαρξη του Αγίου».

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 18.12.2025 (5. децембар ст. ст.) — „Преподобни Карион и Захарија.“

attestations.note: The day’s fourth entry, AN ENUMERATED PAIR — two names in the heading, so BRIEF-SERBIAN §5 counts two, and the corpus holds both. Quoted whole with its closing full stop; URL year 2025. THE IDENTIFICATION WAS MADE ON THE PARENTAGE AND NOT THE NAME, because the corpus holds TWO folders whose display name is the bare «Karion»: `karion-the-martyr`, a `martyr` the Greek calendar keeps on 1 February, and this one, the `venerable` `monk` kept on 24 November. The book’s man is «Отац и син, оба велики подвижници мисирски» — father and son, both great Egyptian ascetics, the father having left a living wife with two children to go to the monks — which is this folder, already `related` in both directions to `zacharias-son-of-carion`, and not the martyr. `types_add`: `ascetic`, off «велики подвижници мисирски», where the folder held `venerable` and `monk`; «велики» is the epithet BRIEF-SERBIAN §5 keeps out of `types`. `dates` UNTOUCHED AND STILL ABSENT: the entry gives no year, no century and no reign, and BRIEF.md §4 says that where the page gives no year there is no `dates` object. NO `locations`: «мисирски» is Egypt, a country and not a place the folder could be pinned to. NO `related` ROW ADDED: his son is already there both ways and is the only person named. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion.
